phase.diagnose: a failed verdict is diagnosed by parallel debuggers before the replan (up to six model sessions per verdict)
phase.gray_areas: the analysis asks the owner which gray areas to discuss and runs an adviser per chosen area (up to six)
phase.research: the plan stage starts with a research step (one model session)
phase.pattern_map: the plan stage maps the code patterns the plan must follow (one model session)
phase.validation: the plan stage writes a validation strategy and an auditor reads it (one model session)
phase.draw_material: the drawing stage first collects design material (one model session)
phase.plan_bounce: an approved plan goes once more through plan-review-convergence; requested changes replan once
phase.design_points: every checkable item of UI-SPEC.md becomes an acceptance line the goal audit must answer
phase.doc_files: the phase writes STATE.md (its marked block), SPEC.md, PLAN.md and VERIFICATION.md into the project and commits them
phase.commit_docs: off: the phase's documents are written but not committed (unset commits, as before)
phase.ambiguity_gate: a plan is not admitted while the share of open planning questions is too high
phase.grill_gate: a plan grilled with open challenges is not admitted until the owner's word or a plan that answers them lifts it (unset: on)
phase.piece_notes: a piece's plan carries its predictions, risk and motion lines
phase.threat_closure: a passed blind verdict fails while a threat row has no file:line mitigation in the code
phase.branch: a closed phase leaves a branch: phase/<id>, or milestone/<slug> of its roadmap section
ship.full_gate: ship stops while the full check is red or older than six hours
review.prepass: strict: a suspicious line found by the review's scan without a model sends the work back; unset, the scan only leaves notes
retro.living: a retro updates the living retrospective file
milestone.archive: closing a milestone archives its phase folders
milestone.summary: closing a milestone writes MILESTONE-SUMMARY.md (one model session)
project.start_research: project start asks about the project, researches the stack and writes requirements (a question to the owner, two model sessions)
ship.watch: the hub posts an owner item when unshipped commits pile up past ship.max_batch_commits or ship.max_batch_days
ship.max_batch_commits: how many unshipped commits make a pile (with ship.watch)
ship.max_batch_days: how many days of unshipped commits make a pile (with ship.watch)
writer.max_turns: a writer attempt is stopped at this many tool calls, its worktree kept (unset: 300; 0: no ceiling)
writer.launch_parity: refuse: a writer that started on another provider than asked is stopped and the pair held for 30 minutes (unset warns)
writer.qa_stop_after: after this many failed QA receipts of a task family the advice is to stop, not to follow up (unset: 2; 0 or off: always a follow-up, as before)
writer.lesson_from_accepted: LESSON: lines of an accepted attempt are filed as lesson proposals
writer.models_off: a list of writer profile keys, provider/model ids or bare model ids no writer is given (the pick and the fallback chain skip them; all off: the task waits, the owner is told)
money.strict: a free subscription member of the writer chain is taken before a free paid one that stands earlier
money.task_ceiling: with a money cap set, a task whose estimate would pass the cap waits for next month
money.cap_unset_zero: an unset money cap reads as zero for paid lanes: a lane paid by the token stays closed until the monthly cap is set, subscription lanes never wait for money (unset: on; off: an unset cap means no limit)
money.silent_estimate_tokens: an attempt whose paid provider reported no usage is priced at this many tokens
hook.prompt_recall: a session's prompt of 3 words or more is answered with pointers to the project's confirmed notes that match its words (word index only, no model call; ON when unset: off silences it)
hook.subagent_pack: a Task call's subagent is born with the project's accepted rules and confirmed memory lessons in its context pack (unset: the pack holds the repo and the window's claimed files only)
docs.gitnexus_refresh: the nightly docs pass refreshes the GitNexus code index (.gitnexus) of a checkout that lacks it or lags HEAD
docs.review: a separate reviewer role reads the docs maintainer's edits before a page is written and committed; a refusal gets one rework round, then an owner item (unset: gate; off: no review)
capability.documentary_gate: a documentary stage holds on a provider whose adapter version has a red documentary receipt; no receipt or a stale one is probed (one cell per stage start, 60 s at most); a probe that could not run is observed and the stage runs, only a probe that answered wrong holds (unset: hold; observe: only logs; lift a hold with bb lane-pilot capabilities --probe)
project.planning_home: the planning home: .agents/phases, .agents/planning and .agents/todos are read and written under this folder on the project's host instead of the checkout's (unset: the checkout)
profile.test_command: infra profile: how the project's checks run
profile.release: infra profile: how a release ships
profile.hosts: infra profile: the machines the project lives on
profile.start: infra profile: how the project starts locally
profile.logs: infra profile: where the logs are
profile.style: infra profile: the owner's working style
verification.ssh_keys: on: this project's checks can read ~/.ssh (the owner's ssh keys), so a check that clones or fetches over ssh works, and a check can also push with them; unset or off: ~/.ssh is masked inside checks, with the other credential stores (publication closed)
verification.copy: a check called from a chat runs in a throwaway copy (a git worktree of the workspace head) instead of the live checkout; a workspace with uncommitted changes is checked where it stands and the measure says so; off: the chat check always runs in the live checkout. A writer's checks run in the attempt's own worktree and the landing sweep in its own, whatever this says (unset: on)
verification.project_suite: the command of the project's own suite; the landing sweep runs it on the merged head in its throwaway worktree and a red one becomes an owner item (unset: the project has none, it is never guessed)
worker.strict_user: on: this project's checks run as a separate OS user (worker.user, lp-worker when none is named) through sudo -n -u, and each task gets a fresh codex home (unset: off, checks run as the owner)
worker.user: the OS user a strict worker's checks run as (unset: lp-worker); read only where worker.strict_user is on
curriculum.weekly: every Monday the hub clusters the week's misses into a ten-line brief (bb lane-pilot curriculum --brief)
task.outcome_file: a finished task leaves OUTCOME.md beside its PLAN.md where the task folder still exists
protection.rearm: off: a protection whose disarm term ended stays off (unset: the daily pass switches it back on, to the level it had before, and tells the owner)
